title: RustConf 2018 - Closing Keynote - Using Rust For Game Development by Catherine West
summary: Catherine West's RustConf 2018 closing keynote on building a game in Rust and organizing a large codebase. It builds up an entity component system and generational indices step by step.
why: HN treats it as the go-to explanation of ECS, valuable even for people who don't use Rust.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: is still my favorite ECS explanation, because she builds the concept piece by piece starting from megaclass-hell to full entities-as-IDs with reasons for each step.
